applicability: A directory under the notes root that has read but not search (x) permission, reached directly or through an in-root directory symlink (the 2026-09-28T16:55:00 ruling places the symlink case under the same ruling).
conditions: The listing process can read the directory but cannot open its children.

Family examination: no joint obligation is supported. Basis: This is a ruled exception that bounds the byte-identity member rather than an obligation supporting the joint guarantee; the family guarantee names it as its one exception.
exclusions: A directory with neither read nor search permission, which still answers 500 as before.
statement: A notes directory that is readable but not searchable lists without its children (HTTP 200) where the path-based walk answered 500; accepted as the one deliberate deviation from byte identity.
